##### Project general facts

Ellington Villa Collection is an exclusive beachfront residential development offering a limited selection of 7-bedroom mansions in one of Dubai’s most prestigious coastal communities. The architecture reflects a bold contemporary beachfront expression, combining expansive layouts, clean modern lines, and seamless integration with the surrounding sea, skyline, and La Mer beachfront. Each residence is designed with generous proportions and open-plan concepts, creating a sense of grandeur, privacy, and elevated coastal living.

The project offers a full spectrum of resort-style amenities distributed across multiple levels, designed to deliver a truly luxurious lifestyle experience. Residents can enjoy private swimming pools with integrated spa and bar areas, infinity-edge pools, fitness zones, landscaped gardens, and dedicated leisure and entertainment spaces. Additional features include games rooms, social lounges with fireplaces, and outdoor relaxation areas, all carefully curated to support both family living and large-scale entertaining in a beachfront setting.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials and bespoke design detailing that reflects Ellington’s signature craftsmanship. Floor-to-ceiling glazing enhances natural light and maximizes views, while spacious bedrooms open onto private terraces and flexible living spaces. The villas are delivered with integrated design elements and premium built-in features, ensuring a refined yet functional living environment, while remaining unfurnished to allow full personalization according to individual taste and lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah is one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential neighborhoods, known for its luxurious beachfront lifestyle, stunning villas, and vibrant community atmosphere. The area offers a perfect blend of modern convenience and serene coastal living, with tree-lined streets, lush parks, and easy access to the pristine Jumeirah Beach.

The neighborhood boasts an array of world-class amenities, including top-rated schools, premium shopping destinations, and fine-dining restaurants. The iconic Jumeirah Beach Road is lined with boutique stores, cozy cafés, and wellness centers, catering to the diverse needs of its residents. Additionally, cultural landmarks like the Jumeirah Mosque and the nearby La Mer waterfront add charm and character to the area, offering both leisure and learning opportunities.

For those who love outdoor activities, Jumeirah provides ample opportunities for fitness and recreation, with beachfront jogging tracks, cycling paths, and water sports facilities. The community is well-connected to the rest of Dubai, with easy access to major highways and business districts. Despite its central location, Jumeirah maintains a peaceful and private ambiance, making it one of the most desirable places to live in Dubai.
